---
title: "worked_example"
---
part one of just loading and viewing the data before any formating
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

breeding_site_locations <- read.csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
migratory_connectivity_dataset <- read.csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")

gt(breeding_site_locations)
colnames(breeding_site_locations)
glimpse(migratory_connectivity_dataset)
gt(head(migratory_connectivity_dataset))
dim(migratory_connectivity_dataset)
```

now creating smaller databases without the junk
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- breeding_site_locations |> 
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)
# gt(bird_breeding_selected)

bird_migration_sites <- migratory_connectivity_dataset |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename( Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, 
          Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, 
          Stopover_Longitude = pslon, 
          Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
          Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
          Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
          Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
          Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)




# length(which(bird_migration_exc$Site != bird_migration_grouped$Site))
```
 removing spain and adjusting the columns
```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_sites |> filter(Site != "Spain")


bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)


glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)
glimpse(bird_migration_exc)
gt(bird_migration_exc)
dim(bird_migration_exc)
str(bird_migration_exc)
table(bird_migration_exc$Site)

lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Stopover = min(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Stopover = mean(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Highest_Lat_Winter = max(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Winter = min(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Winter = mean(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(lat_df)
```
 making a summary table
 
```{r}
bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  )

gt(bird_migration_summary)
```
combining the datasets
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_migration_summary, bird_breeding_exc)

combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)

spring_locations <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")
autumn_locations <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")


bird_data_spring <- combined_bird_piv |> filter(Location_Type %in% spring_locations)
bird_data_autumn <- combined_bird_piv |> filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_locations)
```


saving data
```{r}
write_csv(bird_data_spring, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(bird_data_autumn, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```


making graphs
```{r}

min_long <- bird_data_spring |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()

max_long <- bird_data_spring |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()

min_lat <- bird_data_spring |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()

max_lat <- bird_data_spring |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()


ggplot(bird_data_spring,
       aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude, colour = Site, shape = Location_Type)) +
      geom_point(size = 2.8) +
       annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
     coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_long - 2, max_long + 2),
                    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat +2)) +
  ggtitle("Spring Migration Routes for Pied Flycatcher") 


ggplot(bird_data_autumn,
      aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude, colour = Site, shape = Location_Type))+
      geom_point(size=3) + 
      annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2)
      # need to add the limits for autumn
  
  
```
